Ceridwen is a solider of the UFS and part of the Wizard Project.



Personality
A self-reliant and confident person, She remains calm and is able to joke even in dangerous situations. She hides a degree of bitterness against the UFS that changed her into a cyborg. She is still one of the most loyal and fearless members of Wizard Project.

Appearance
She has short blond hair and green eyes. Her real face looks more like a facemask.

History
Background
A mercenary of the dark streets with unknown background. Captured and changed by "Project Wizard" a secret UFS project, the same Faust Wizard 13 was modified in.

Originally an orphan child, which collected trash and food in the slums, she was crushed by a military vehicle. Around 40% of her body has been replaced with bionics, even with a full transformative control of facial features. As such, Ceridwen face now is no longer human but mechanical, but is able to take on any form she desires. She became a master assassin with her ability to blend in, watching other soldiers that were produced by Project Wizard. Known as the ninth cyborg that swore absolute loyalty to the UFS. Ceridwen keeps tabs on other, "Wizard Project" cyborgs like Iris Wizard 14, which herself tries to find the missing Faust Wizard 13.

Timeline TABA
In a "what if" event, captured after defeating multiple members of the Fuuma Organization.

Advertisement
Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Metal Blades from hands

Able to produce metal blades from body
Face Shifting: Able to change her face into any female face with the help of bionics.
Media
Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena
Trivia
Her face is in fact "fake" and the mask is her real face.
Her ability to change faces is somewhat similar to Ares.
